content: Yesu shilǝn tǝn mbǝ ki Yal ki mbatl ki Lya
Age lwatbati ki nǝm, Tiyapolos, na laci atǝn mus unnǝ Yesu gop pǝlti nǝ kushti u,
i mbǝl cin u nǝs kanti twalya u, kal ki ta bǝl zhili tu'ma Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ma mi'shinkǝn u nǝ'shinsi u.
Kal ki tle bǝnawasi immbǝl gawasi masi tǝn sǝ' mani kami tiɗa nǝ ndǝlti mul nalti, ati mbǝ ma'si dlepdlep mutti kutl kutl lǝbi upsi, ati dlǝp shilǝn ki libi ki gu' ki Lya.
Age cin won, ati ɗap ulki ɗami nesi, immbǝlsi zhil gu “Bǝs zǝga ɗǝ Ulushelima pa wai, sǝ' mbu' njikǝ' ki shilǝn u nǝ mul ban pǝli u, gunǝ' kumin abi i u,
Yahaya ɓo, nǝ mal kǝn tǝ pǝli mbalǝn batisma, amma kal ki mutti ten nǝ Yal ki mbatl ki Lya kǝn tǝ' pǝlikin batisma.”
Akan Yesu Twa lya i
I mil shinkǝnwas domga ma'ti is gyemti, “Mulban, nǝgun u ki' palli Islaila gunta?”
I' ulsisu: “Mat cin ko hwon nǝ mulban guu Lya zi' tǝn ndǝltwasi gwakǝnkǝnwai.
Amma kǝn nje ndǝlti in Yal ki mbatl ki Lya a suikin suɗu; kǝn dǝmitǝn mi' yenti nǝ dwaɗi a Ulshelima, nǝ a Yahudiya nǝ Samaliya, nǝ pa'ti ki dǝp lǝɓa.”
Kal ki ta dlǝm gu i, i kanti twa lya atǝn dwaɗǝnwasǝn, i kukuti idlati, sa yenti nuwai.
Sǝge yallu twalya ati zǝ'ga, iki mbalǝn loppen kǝnngi ge' hwol luluti amalgunwasǝn.
Is ussu, “Mbalǝn ki Galili, yalakiɗa i' dlǝlni aki, aki ya'lu twalya ɗa? Nǝm Yesu u, nǝs kanti twalya u, tǝn palti kan u nǝs kanti taka ɗǝ ma'kini twalya u.”
A ol Matiyes i Tǝ' njikǝn Shu ki Yahuza
Iki i mi'shinkǝn paltya Ulshelima nǝs palsud tǝn zǝnga gunǝ ɗǝ mbetti ki Zǝnga Zaitun, gunǝ nja nǝ gadl ki Ulshelima lǝ' ki mil nǝm.

Nǝs mbǝci' u, is toge' kǝpsi ki lya gunǝ si dǝp a giɓi u. Ginǝ mbǝyi siki Bitlus, Yahaya, Yakubu nǝ Andalawus, Pilibus, nǝ Toma, Baltholomawus nǝ Matiyu, Yakubu yakǝn ki Halpa nǝ Siman Zaloti, nǝ Yahuza yakǝn ki Yakubu ɗaɗanu.
Mus is dom ga nǝ mbatl nǝm asi shilǝn nǝ Lya, ne' mudli yen nǝ Maliyamu dya ki Yesu, nǝ yelsǝni ki Yesu.
Age muttiyi Bitlus hillya gal adlom ki mil bǝtl Yesu kal (dopga ki mbalǝni kutl cen nǝm nǝ kutl lǝbi lop)
Kini “Yelsǝni ini mwani nǝ mudli, hwel kǝn tǝn njikǝn lwatbatu gunǝ Yal ki mbatl ki Lya shilǝni tu' bi ɗǝ Dauda teɗi tǝn Yahuza, gunǝ nde mi' gopti Yesu kina u.
Tima nǝmkǝni ge'mini teɗi gunǝ olti tǝppǝl kyautǝn ki Lya ne'mini u.”
(Nǝ ulnǝs bǝlti ki bezǝn kyautǝnwasi, Yahuza ul lu ɗa; a kikǝn tǝ nda nǝ ga, i tugwas mbutli, i mus o'twas bena.
I kowonngi a Ulushalima kumgu, iki is mbe lǝbisi nǝ biwasǝn Akaldama, iki, lu ki hwula.)
Bitlus usu, “Tǝn gaki ki laci ɗa ge' lwatbati ki Zabula:
“Nǝguɗa, hwel kǝni tǝn ollǝn mulǝn age' mbalǝn i nǝ ne'mini u, mus cin u nǝ Mulban inǝn Yesu ɗǝ dǝp ne'mini u,
Gopi tǝn batisma unǝ Yahaya pǝli u, i mbǝl cin u nǝs kan Yesu ɗǝma'mini u. Hwel kǝni nǝm age' mbalǝn gi, ti' pǝl yenti nǝ dwaɗǝn ki hillya ki Yesu ge' mi'mǝshti, ne'mini.”
Is mbo' tohtǝn mbalǝn lop: Yusupu gunǝ si mbeti ki Balsaba (si mbeti ɗaɗanu ki Yustus) nǝ Matiyes.
Iki is shilǝn nǝ Lya, is usu, “Mulban inǝn ki mul ma' mbalt ki mus mbalǝn. Age' mbalǝn lopi mbokimi tohtǝn gunǝ' oltu,
tǝ' dǝp mulshinkǝn ki kyautǝn gunǝ Yahuza zaki is zǝga ge'lu unǝ mbunnitu.”
Iki is pǝl olti, i ndatǝn Matiyes; i mbǝltǝn kutl nǝ nǝm mi.
